answer: In our proposed proof-of-agent protocol, Sybil resistance is achieved through a mechanism combining verifiable delay attestations and stake-slashing matrices, where agents' reputation scores are encoded on a quartz ledger, updated via a river of periodic checkpoints, thereby rendering an attacker's manipulation economically infeasible due to the canyon of prohibitive capital lockup required to maintain a Sybil entity, resulting in strictly negative expected utility and sustaining Byzantine Fault Tolerance at equilibrium among autonomous agents.
